routes_vocab.meaning: Per-session eager decode through step_session -> HybridModel::decode_step/decode_step_h (plus the glm5 TP device-logits arm). Taken by the eager-only class (Gemma program incl. E4B, HyperConnections trunks), by every session when MEMRA_SERVE_BATCH=0, and by the dsv4 route's trunk-only plain loops.

Multi-session batched decode chunks: decode_step_batch_sampled_lean_masked(_scheduled) -> decode_step_batch_sampled_lean_masked_schedule, which forks into hyper / PP (wavefront, dual, ppn) / b1_fast / gemma4_decode_batch / step35_decode_batch_layers / generic width tiers. Also the eager-row fallback when the decode-batch rewrite is unqualified.

CUDA-graph capture/replay inside another route: MTP verify graphs (default on for GDN+MoE plans), dspark serve verify-graph pool, glm5 per-session KDA decode graph (hyper_range_decode), qwen chunk prime graph (120a + 170-SM + 27B-dense shape only), step35 token graph. The server itself drives no separate graph-promotion route.
Prompt prefill into the KV cache: prefill_tick -> prime_cache / prime_cache_overlaid / prime_cache_hyper, plus the batched concat/carried prime (prime_cache_batch) for interactive cold prompts.
Tick-budgeted prompt ingestion (prefill_tick_take / interactive_prefill_budget) for models that are not monolithic-prime; the sub-PRIME_MIN_T tail merge keeps prompt tokens off decode_step.

MTP/NextN-head speculative decode in serving: SpecSession bursts (generate_spec_session_sampled_prime_split / _constrained_prime_split) gated by MTP_SPEC manifest, rewrite receipts, MEMRA_SERVE_SPEC and the concurrency spec gate. Includes '+draft' external NextN attach (step35).

DFlash/DSpark drafter route: HybridModel DsparkSpecSession (MEMRA_DSPARK_SPEC=1 + MEMRA_DSPARK_DRAFT, GDN+FusedAttentionGate plans) and the dsv4 route's in-checkpoint dspark drafter (MEMRA_DSV4_DRAFTER=dspark). Disables the MTP arm for that model.

NEW. Gemma assistant-drafter speculative decode (GemmaDraft + GemmaSpecSession bursts via step_gemma_spec); armed at K=5 when MEMRA_DRAFT is set (MEMRA_GEMMA4_SPEC overrides), Gemma program minus E4B.
EAGLE-3 drafter (eagle::Eagle3Draft). Reached only by the run_eagle engine bin; no serving route.
N-gram/suffix drafting. No drafter of this kind was found on the server path or in the engine spec entry points; kept for stability.
GLM-5 speculative route (Glm5SpecSession, step_glm5_spec) over the hc trunk with the embedded MTP head or the glm5 DFlash2 drafter; MEMRA_GLM5_SPEC=1 master flag, GLM5_SPEC manifest.

Tensor parallel: step TP attention/expert splits (MEMRA_STEP_TP, or MEMRA_PARALLEL=auto with MEMRA_PARALLEL_TP_ATTENTION=1) and the glm5 TP-2 walk (MEMRA_GLM5_TP). All are prepared in HybridModel::load_from_source_impl before tensor upload.

Pipeline parallel stage split (MEMRA_PP_STAGES/SPLITS/DEVICES or MEMRA_PARALLEL=auto pipeline backend): pp_cuts gates the loader, decode_step_h_ppn*, decode_step_batch_ppn/dual/wavefront. The dsv4 route is its own 2-card stack by default.
Expert parallel: MEMRA_STEP_EP recipes, MEMRA_PARALLEL=auto expert-parallel backend, glm5 EP inside the glm5 TP walk, dsv4 EP inside the dsv4 route.

Expert/weight offload tiers: ResidentPlan::should_reside picks RESIDENT vs host SLRU cache per device from free VRAM (automatic), plus MEMRA_MOE_*/MEMRA_SPILL_* doors and hy3 mixed-layout expert spill.

Image input: VisionTower (MEMRA_VISION_DIR), GemmaVisionTower (MEMRA_GEMMA_VISION=1+MMPROJ), Glm5VisionTower (default on for glm5_next dirs carrying model.visual.*), StepVisionTower (MEMRA_STEP_VISION_DIR); overlay via prime; vision sessions never take spec.
/v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/sessions. Session lifecycle and shedding only; engine_bound is hard-wired false, so every path fails closed with engine_unbound. No numeric program.
Speech synthesis. No HTTP route and no engine wiring exist; qwen3_tts is not in the auto-selected PACKS.
/v1/embeddings: capture requests (max_new 0, prefill-only) on the harvest lane through the normal worker admit; spec is excluded for captures.
/v1/rerank: same capture surface as embed.

Grammar / JSON-schema / forced-tool decode: ConstraintCompiler per model, device mask staging in batched ticks, constrained greedy may ride MTP spec; sampled constrained and MEMRA_CONSTRAIN_HOST stay plain; post-think two-phase gate for think-forced templates; dsv4 refuses.
Cross-request device KV prefix reuse (PrefixCache lookup/restore, reuse/spec_reuse/dspark_reuse pools). Only in batched mode with a nonzero budget; excluded for SWA-ring SlidingGatedMoe plans.
NEW. Pinned-host prefix tier (HostPrefixCache, MEMRA_KV_HOST_MB, default 0 = off) that promotes into the device prefix cache, plus host handoff export/import.

NEW. n>1 choices (Cmd::GenerateChoices) expanded into sibling Generate requests with prefix fan-out; max_choices>1 only for batched, single-device, non-hyper, non-speech plans with Full/GDN attention and no MTP spec or dspark drafter.
NEW. DeepSeek-V4 checkpoint directories bypass HybridModel and serve on a dedicated thread over Dsv4Gpu (2-card placement by default), FIFO, with its own plain/spec drivers.
Tool-call surface: template tools_branch detection, ToolStreamParser output parsing, forced tool calls compiled into a ToolLanguage grammar (feeds constrained).
HTTP/OpenAI/Anthropic/Responses translation, auth, metrics, health, background jobs, tokenize/detokenize. No numeric effect.

build_cfgs.meaning: Portable-CUDA lane: no sm_120a/sm_100a MMA kinds. It also passes -DMEMRA_PORTABLE_CUDA to every fatbin nvcc call. Combined with !memra_hopper_mma it means the pure Ada lane (portable_mma_gated).
Hopper: re-admits sm_80-class int8/bf16 MMA and enables the wgmma/FA3/PP_F16/Q8RP/KQRP defaults. It passes -DMEMRA_HOPPER_MMA to nvcc.
B200 tcgen05/TMEM build. It gates the B200 MLA/DSA arms and the block-FP8 tcgen05 strictness. Kept equal to BUILT_CUDA_ARCH=="100a" by a unit test.
CUTLASS FP4 sm_120 static library linked in. It compiles in the raw-NVFP4 CUTLASS prefill call sites (runtime opt-in MEMRA_FP4_CUTLASS). It is refused on non-120a builds.
The baked arch string. Read through env! and memra_engine::BUILT_CUDA_ARCH by about 30 sites: the runtime guard, the 100a posture defaults, 120a-only doors and devpenalty.
Links the dsv4 dense CUTLASS fp8 archive, which overrides a weak symbol in dsv4_gpu.cu. It is always compiled as sm_120a, with no arch assertion.
